calculation.description: Cross-asset dispersion regime conditions a low-risk directional breadth signal. When trailing 20-session cross-asset return dispersion is above its trailing 252-session median, retain each instrument's 20-session positive-return breadth in excess of 0.5 divided by its 20-session realized volatility; otherwise set the cross-sectional signal to zero. The complete signal is lagged one session to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark gates on 2,356 valid dates with all 15 instruments available. Recent 120- and 756-date windows are positive; 252- and 1260-date ICIR are weak, so regime drift remains material.
